LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_BondReleaseAftereffect.label: Bond release aftereffect
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_BondReleaseAftereffect.descri: The bond of control between master and slave has been severed. The body still waits for orders. Limbs feel heavy and movements keep faltering. It takes time to get used to life without a master again.
